episodes.title: I Don't Know
episodes.summary: Young musician Bess King races from job to job in New York while trying to find the courage to perform her own material.

episodes.title: I Will Survive
episodes.summary: Taking her brother Louie's advice, Bess gets rehired at the club—and her first paying gig thanks to her friend and coworker Benny.

episodes.title: Dear Hope
episodes.summary: Bess tries creating a song about hope for a songwriting competition, but is left reeling by an incident involving her roommate, Prisha.

episodes.title: Love Hurts
episodes.summary: Bess and Samuel are awarded the opportunity to record at legendary Electric Lady Studios—and are joined by Bess's father, Percy.

episodes.title: Quick, Quick Slow
episodes.summary: When she decides to make a music video, Bess asks Ethan to direct and enlists all her of her friends to help make it a DIY masterpiece.

episodes.title: Tell Her
episodes.summary: Ethan's decision to stay with Laila causes Bess to spiral into self-destruction, which has far-reaching consequences.

episodes.title: Ghost Light
episodes.summary: Just as Benny sets up a series of meetings with record executives, Bess experiences a setback.

episodes.title: Sea Change
episodes.summary: With her family in turmoil and romantic life torn, Bess nears a breaking point.

episodes.title: Sing What I Can't Say
episodes.summary: A secret is revealed about Bess' past - and she faces her fears.
